items.sub: Mixidev · Bullet Heaven, Action, Action Roguelike

items.name: Rubinite
items.desc: Rubinite is an extremely challenging boss rush action game. in a dark fairy tale world, use Ruby's crimson eyes to expose the weak points of the Bloodstained monsters, then strike and shatter them. Carve a road home through the ruined Scarlet Kingdom and face the Witch who took it all.

items.name: A Thousand Cloys
items.desc: A chill, exploration-based incremental game about harvesting and cleansing an alien planet of its radiation with a swarm of high-tech toasters.

items.name: BALL PICKER - Clean Up the Golf Yard
items.desc: Collect hundreds of thousands of golf balls, earn money, buy new tools, and clean up the golf yard. BALL PICKER is an active incremental game centered on the quiet satisfaction of tidying up.

items.name: Rat Game
items.desc: Asymmetrical horror comedy co-op for up to 8 players. Play either a pack of Rats trying to sabotage a restaurant, or the Chef determined to stop them.

items.name: Japanese Ramen Simulator
items.sub: Wild Dog · Casual, Simulation, Early Access
items.desc: Japanese Ramen Simulator is a ramen shop management sim for up to six players. Prepare ingredients, cook noodles, and arrange toppings to craft the perfect bowl. Create original dishes, design your kitchen and dining area, and build your ramen restaurant with friends or on your own!

items.name: Cairn
items.sub: The Game Bakers · Action, Adventure, Simulation
items.desc: Reach a summit never climbed before in this survival-climber from the creators of Furi and Haven. Climb anywhere and plan your route carefully, managing pitons and resources to survive unforgiving Mount Kami. Discover what Aava is willing to sacrifice to achieve the ascent of a lifetime.

items.name: Rubinite
items.desc: Rubinite is an extremely challenging boss rush action game. in a dark fairy tale world, use Ruby's crimson eyes to expose the weak points of the Bloodstained monsters, then strike and shatter them. Carve a road home through the ruined Scarlet Kingdom and face the Witch who took it all.

items.name: Mortal Sin

items.desc: Mortal Sin is a chaotic, blood-soaked roguelike where skill is power, and overconfidence is death. Carve through procedurally generated nightmares with brutal melee and flashy, satisfying combos.

items.name: CloverPit
items.desc: A rogue-lite slot machine nightmare. Gamble for your life in a never-ending debt simulator!

items.name: SHRED A BILLION
items.desc: SHRED A BILLION is a first-person incremental game about a mountain of money! Grab bills by hand, scoop them with a bucket, level up and feed a billion dollars to the shredder. Only 999,999,999 bills left to go!

items.name: Ravenswatch
items.sub: Passtech Games · Rogue-like, Co-op, Action Roguelike
items.desc: Fallen heroes of old folk tales and legends: you are on the verge of a crucial battle against the Nightmare invading and corrupting your world. A roguelike action game from the creators of Curse of the Dead Gods©, playable solo or in online co-op.

items.name: 装甲奇兵
items.desc: Drive an armored war machine through endless enemy waves. A survivors-like shooter: auto-fire, dodge, unleash ultimates, pick upgrades and set the field ablaze. Start with Eileen / Ghost, unlock two more crews, fight nine stages, and push each battlefield from Easy to Nightmare.

items.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
items.desc: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

items.name: The Retrospection Of Tomorrow
items.desc: A time-travel romance visual novel where sweet dates quickly turn into a high-stakes mystery...as handsome boys around you start dying right before your eyes! Trapped between dreams and memories, fighting fate itself—can you find a way to save everyone? Dear time traveler, welcome home.

items.name: Astral Forge: Desktop Alchemist
items.sub: ZhiSu Studio · Casual, Simulation, Early Access
items.desc: A desktop alchemy game. Type and move your mouse to gather resources; control the heat, forge items, find rare affixes and fill your collection. Exchange supplies with other players. Eligible items can enter Steam Inventory and the Community Market. Internet required.

items.name: Depthline
items.desc: Go 18 floors down a quarantined building. Pick the room, watch your survivor gun down the zombies and grab the gear they drop. Merge twins into rarer items, stack class bonuses and build a loadout that can reach Patient Zero. An inventory-management roguelite where the build wins the fight.
